CBSA.CICSBSA.ABNDFILE.recovery_why: etc/install/base/installjcl/BANK.csd: DEFINE FILE(ABNDFILE) ... RECOVERY(NONE) -- the abend log a backout must not undo

scenarios.name: amount-zero
scenarios.why: boundary: COMM-AMT <= 0 -> 'N' '4' and RETURN before any SQL; sort codes still overwritten with 987654

scenarios.name: amount-negative
scenarios.why: a negative amount: 'N' '4', nothing read or written

scenarios.name: same-account
scenarios.why: FACCNO = TACCNO (sort codes both 987654): ABNDINFO from the clock and EIB, LINK ABNDPROC (an ABNDFILE record, RECOVERY(NONE)), ABEND SAME CANCEL; no SQL

scenarios.name: same-account-other-sortcodes
scenarios.why: the caller's sort codes 111111 / 222222 are overwritten by the program's 987654 before the compare, so still 'SAME'

notes: CBSA's transfer service (XFRFUN) on GENERATED Db2 rows (#4507): 30 IBMUSER.ACCOUNT rows built from CRETB01's CREATE TABLE and CREI101's unique index (every column at its boundaries, a NULL in every nullable column, then values between; a quarter under another sort code); PROCTRAN starts empty and is compared with ACCOUNT after every task (no foreign key joins them in CRETB02). 40 generated LINKs with BNK1TFN's SUBPGM-PARMS: the FROM account each row's in turn, the TO account any row's, one in ten an account the table does not hold (SELECT +100, rollback), amounts from the smallest to the S9(10)V99 maximum, zero and negative; a generated NULL date reaches SELECT -305 and the abend. The hand scenarios of cbsa-xfrfun that need no particular row (amount <= 0, FROM = TO) stay. Every task's statements are compared with what Db2 answered (compare_sql). Burned estate (CBSA). A generated NULL date read into the TO account's host variables (no indicator) leaves them unset, so the UPDATE that follows is rejected by Db2 with -180 (SQLSTATE 22007); the JDBC driver refuses those bytes on the client, so the Java outcome log records the statement with Db2's answer (EquivalenceDb2Config, #4658).
